properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 is a resolved indirect dependency (pulled by elliptic 6.5.4). Its SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations ship with the build; no first-party call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Classical secp256k1 ECDSA signature support for NEAR accounts (KeyType.SECP256K1) — Shor-vulnerable, deadline problem; NEAR chain curve, so observable here but replacement is decided by the protocol, not this repo alone. One logical asset across code, tests and lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All Math.random uses are for non-security purposes: wallet-list ordering in the modal UI, word selection for a suggested PUBLIC account name, and a jest mock. Production randomness uses crypto.getRandomValues (CSPRNG, webauthn-utils.ts:22). No secrets, keys or challenges derive from Math.random.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305 and @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 entries in pnpm-lock.yaml — Poly1305 MAC ships transitively in the browser bundle. Available in the shipped library; no application call site found in workspace sources.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 entry — the single-round MD5-based EVP_BytesToKey KDF, pulled by the crypto-browserify browser shim (a direct runtime dependency). Available in the shipped bundle; no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 entry — the OpenSSH bcrypt-KDF package (transitive, e.g. via sshpk/node-forge chain), not general password hashing by this app. Available in the shipped bundle; no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge@1.3.1 ships RSA (and X.509 tooling) into the bundle. No application call site found in workspace sources; presence is what the inventory records here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves@^1.8.1 is a direct dependency of packages/webauthn-wallet and genuinely imported there (ed25519 from @noble/curves/ed25519); secp256k1 is one of the curves the library ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the primary NEAR account-key signature scheme across this wallet selector, Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-DSA-65 pending NEAR protocol evolution). Production sites: keypair generation via KeyPair.fromRandom("ed25519") (my-near-wallet mnw-connect.ts:156,261; intear-wallet.ts:591; ethereum-wallets index.ts:1001 access key; wallet-connect.ts:451 KeyPairEd25519.fromRandom() session key), signature assembly and key-type detection in wallet-utils/src/lib/sign-transactions.ts (KeyType.ED25519

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh@4.0.4 entries — ECDH lands in the browser bundle via crypto-browserify (a direct runtime dependency used for browser polyfills). Available in the shipped library; no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/x25519@1.0.3 — X25519 key agreement, Shor-vulnerable (retroactively breakable once quantum hardware matures). Ships as an indirect dependency of wallet SDKs; no first-party call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: webauthn-wallet declares @noble/curves@^1.8.1; its ed25519 module is the implementation behind webauthn-utils.ts:32 (ed25519.getPublicKey(secretKey), deriving the NEAR signing keypair from SHA-256 of the WebAuthn credential ID) — a use site of ALG-5e08bdf5. Same logical asset: Ed25519 in this repo, reached here via dependency declaration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic@6.5.4 (transitive web3 dep) ships ECDSA over secp256k1/P-256. No first-party call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256/ECDSA posture is real in this package, not just vendored: the WebAuthn passkey creation in webauthn-utils.ts offers ES256 (COSE alg -7, ECDSA P-256) first in pubKeyCredParams. @noble/curves provides the P-256 implementation. Shor-vulnerable signature.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 provides X25519 (crypto_box / scalar multiplication) and ships transitively via the @near-js/crypto stack. Available in the shipped bundle; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 used to derive an Ethereum-style identifier from a NEAR receiverId in the ethereum-wallets bridge. Note: the live call site imports keccak256 from viem (^2.21.26, ethereum-wallets/src/lib/index.ts:33), while the lockfile also carries @ethersproject/keccak256 5.7.0 and keccak 3.0.4 — remediation should bump viem, not ethers. Quantum-irrelevant (hash primitive).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2 ships via ethers 5.7.2 (@ethersproject/pbkdf2, keystore key derivation) and the pbkdf2 3.1.3 browserify polyfill (crypto-browserify/near-seed-phrase chain). No first-party PBKDF2 call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@3.0.1 (transitive via the ethers/ethereum stack, where scrypt protects JSON keystores). Available in the shipped bundle; no application call site in workspace sources.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/hkdf@1.0.1 (indirect dependency via wallet SDK deps). No first-party HKDF call site in this repo; the KDF ships with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 digest of the WebAuthn credentialId — and the digest is then used DIRECTLY as the Ed25519 private key in deriveKeyPairFromCredentialId (unhardened hash of a public identifier as long-term signing key material). Weak KDF design; changeable here. The Ed25519 side is a separate inventory entry.

properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.7.1 is a direct dependency (root package.json); SHA-256 is one of the primitives it ships. Concrete first-party SHA-256 uses go through WebCrypto (crypto.subtle.digest) and js-sha256 — separate inventory entries.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 — the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD ships transitively in the bundle (@stablelib chain used by WalletConnect libraries). No application call site in workspace sources.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 ships nacl.secretbox/nacl.box (XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD) transitively via the near stack. Available in the shipped bundle; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Key-management infrastructure reference: the Azure Key Vault secrets client (@azure/keyvault-secrets@^4.9.0) is in the dependency tree transitively via a wallet SDK chain — 45 lockfile entries. No application call site in workspace sources. The vault service itself is Azure-operated: observable here, its key-algorithm lineup (RSA, EC, and Azure's PQ offerings) decided by the vendor; the dependency is changeable here.
